conversionNotes: SpaceTrace default preparation: 128-tap minimum-phase HRIRs generated from the official IRCAM LISTEN 1050 SOFA data; onset and broadband interaural delay preserved on a quarter-sample grid; no historical game asset is redistributed
releaseNote: SOFA remains the archival/source format. head.sthrtf is a derived SpaceTrace runtime representation; preserve the original source and license/provenance.

stereoPairResidualComposition.capture: Dataset Corrected, Stereo Pair, selected head, otherwise default settings; host pan centered
stereoPairResidualComposition.method: Convolve each preserved base source-leg correction with the common residual, then apply a half-cosine fade over the final 40 ms
stereoPairResidualComposition.gainPolicy: No normalization or gain makeup; existing source/ear balance and fixed trims preserved; tiny response change from final tail taper quantified in results
stereoPairResidualComposition.runtime: Existing source-leg convolutions only; active at all Stereo Pair positions in Dataset Corrected mode
stereoPairResidualComposition.head1OutputBalance: Separate pending calibration; not included in this EQ composition

left.method: full linear convolution; optional final tail taper; float64 calculation, float32 WAV

right.method: full linear convolution; optional final tail taper; float64 calculation, float32 WAV

stereoPairResidualComposition.license: Retain the corresponding head LICENSE.txt and Licenses/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt terms for all head-derived components and plots

monoLevelCalibration.method: Front center 0/0 degrees at native head sample rate, including runtime fractional-delay magnitude, Dataset Corrected, 1 metre, 80-16000 Hz pink weighting; average ear power matches unit mono source. Fixed gain also applies in Raw/Custom to preserve correction gain differences. Stereo Pair and Papa Pan excluded.
